title: Why Apple Stock Needs to Report a Good Number
text: Why Apple Stock Needs to Report a Good Number Market Looks to Apple for AssuranceMark November 1 on your calendar. Not because we will be closing off a horrific October for stocks that saw the Nasdaq and Russell 2000 indices plummet into correction territory, but it's the day trillion-dollar behemoth Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) reports.The numbers better be fairly good since AAPL stock has largely avoided the stock market carnage that has inflicted the rest of the FAANG group, consisting of Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB); Apple; Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX); and Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOG).The market appears.
